note: Blocache adds a Cache Settings section (Override cacheability metadata + Max-Age/Contexts/Tags tabs) to every block config form, gated by the 'administer block cache' permission. It has no configure route; per-block settings are stored as block third-party settings under the blocache namespace: block.block.<id>.third_party_settings.blocache.overridden (bool) and .metadata ({max-age, contexts, tags}), schema block.block.*.third_party.blocache. max-age semantics: -1 permanent, 0 not cacheable (also fires page_cache_kill_switch), positive seconds. At render, hook_entity_type_build swaps the block view builder to BlocacheViewBuilder, which merges the override into #cache only when overridden is TRUE. Medium/hard cases use a namespaced block (blocache_eval/blocache_task) and read/write those third-party settings on the live block entity.

evals.prompt: The Drupal blocache module lets you configure the cache of an individual block, but it has no admin settings page. Where does it store a block's overridden cache settings?
evals.expected_output: As block third-party settings under the blocache namespace: block.block.<id>.third_party_settings.blocache.overridden (bool) and .metadata (max-age/contexts/tags). There is no configure route; the UI is on each block's own config form.

evals.prompt: Which permission does the blocache module define, and what does it control?
evals.expected_output: It defines 'administer block cache'. Only users with it see the Cache Settings section (Override cacheability metadata + Max-Age/Contexts/Tags) on the block configuration form.

evals.prompt: With the blocache module, which three pieces of cacheability metadata can you override on a single block, and what does a max-age of 0 mean?
evals.expected_output: Max-age, cache contexts, and cache tags. max-age 0 means the block is not cacheable (and blocache fires the page_cache_kill_switch so the containing page is not page-cached); -1 means cache permanently; a positive number is seconds.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a block whose id is blocache_eval, and blocache has been used to override its cacheability. Inspect the live block configuration and state the overridden max-age (in seconds) that blocache applies to it.
evals.expected_output: The block blocache_eval has third_party_settings.blocache.overridden = true and metadata.max-age = 137 (drush cget block.block.blocache_eval third_party_settings.blocache, or Block::load('blocache_eval')->getThirdPartySetting('blocache','metadata')).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a placed block with id blocache_task. Using the blocache module, override its cacheability so that the block is not cacheable (max-age 0). Apply the change to the live block configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set the block's blocache third-party settings: overridden = TRUE and metadata.max-age = 0 (e.g. Block::load('blocache_task')->setThirdPartySetting('blocache','overridden',TRUE)->setThirdPartySetting('blocache','metadata',['max-age'=>0,'contexts'=>[],'tags'=>[]])->save()). Verified: overridden === true and metadata max-age === 0.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the block with id blocache_ctx has had its cacheability overridden with blocache to add a cache context. Inspect the live block configuration and state which cache context blocache adds to it.
evals.expected_output: The block blocache_ctx has third_party_settings.blocache.metadata.contexts containing 'url.path' (drush cget block.block.blocache_ctx third_party_settings.blocache).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a placed block with id blocache_tagtask. Using the blocache module, override its cacheability and add the cache tag `node_list` so the block is invalidated whenever the node list changes. Apply the change to the live block configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set the block's blocache third-party settings: overridden = TRUE and metadata.tags including 'node_list' (e.g. setThirdPartySetting('blocache','metadata',['max-age'=>-1,'contexts'=>[],'tags'=>['node_list']])). Verified: overridden === true and metadata.tags contains node_list.
